content.faq_q1: Do I need a YouTube API key to use this tool?
content.faq_a1: No! Our tool extracts publicly available video data without requiring any API keys, registration, or authentication. Simply paste the video URL and get instant results.
content.faq_q2: What data can I extract from YouTube videos?
content.faq_a2: You can extract comprehensive data including video title, description, tags, view count, likes, channel name, publish date, category, duration, thumbnail, and more. All data is displayed in an easy-to-read format with copy buttons.
content.faq_q3: Can I use this for competitor analysis?
content.faq_a3: Absolutely! This tool is perfect for competitive analysis. Extract data from competitor videos to understand their SEO strategy, content approach, and what makes their videos successful.
content.faq_q4: Is there a limit on how many videos I can analyze?
content.faq_a4: No limits! You can extract data from as many YouTube videos as you need, completely free. There are no daily limits, no registration required, and no hidden fees.
content.faq_q5: Can I copy the extracted data?
content.faq_a5: Yes! We provide one-click copy buttons for title, description, and tags. You can easily copy any data field and use it for your own content creation, research, or analysis purposes.
